question: The weekly earnings of a shopkeeper in February 2021 are ₹21,980, ₹20,580, ₹22,380, ₹22,616, respectively. What is his average daily income in February 2021?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of earnings = 21,980 + 20,580 + 22,380 + 22,616 = ₹87,556

Days in February 2021 (non-leap year) = 28 days

Average daily income = Total Income ÷ Total Days

Average daily income = 87,556 ÷ 28 = ₹3,127

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Leap Year Calculation

A year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4, except for century years which must be divisible by 400. February has 29 days in a leap year and 28 days in a non-leap year.

Basic Average Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations). This is also known as the Arithmetic Mean.

Weighted Average

When different groups have different counts, the weighted average is used: (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
